slides.say: Strict Mode turns on extra checks in development for everything inside it.
Wrap your root component. The docs recommend it for the whole app, especially new ones.

slides.text: Extra render • extra Effect setup+cleanup • extra ref callback run • deprecated API warnings.
slides.say: Components render one extra time, Effects and ref callbacks run setup and cleanup one extra time, and deprecated APIs are flagged.

slides.text: Development only. No opting out inside the tree.
slides.say: All of this is development only, so production is not slowed down. And there is no way to opt a part out inside a Strict Mode tree.
